subject: Marketplace MAP: procurement checkpoints & billing path for StratusAI (AWS private offer)
messages:
From: Lila Chen <lila@stratusai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, procurement@stratusai.com
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Starting MAP + AWS private offer question

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at StratusAI is excited about Redwood's latency numbers and the Dedicated option for our inference workloads. Procurement asked me to put together a simple mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align milestones toward a PO. A couple of asks up front: 

- We want to understand the billing path if we go via an AWS Private Offer vs. a direct invoice. Which route is faster for us (we're seeking a June production target)?
- Our cloud team will likely want to pin a specific model and region for the evaluation. Can you call out expected time to provision dedicated nodes once a PO is issued?
- We may need a short SOC2/KMS note for legal — can you point me to the right contacts and any artifacts?

I've looped in Procurement (procurement@stratusai.com) and Marco (marco) who will handle invoicing. Can you share a draft MAP and a quick timeline (key checkpoints + owners)?

Thanks —
Lila Chen
Head of ML Platform, StratusAI

(attachment: initial-requirements-stratusai.pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lila Chen <lila@stratusai.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Starting MAP + AWS private offer question

Hi Lila — great to hear and thanks for the clear asks. I've sketched a short MAP below and attached a one-page draft (StratusAI_MPA_DRAFT_v1.pdf) and a pricing summary. High level: we can support both AWS Private Offer (Marketplace) and direct invoicing; private offer typically speeds procurement sign-off for buyers who want cloud-native billing and consolidated cost reporting, but timing varies by procurement org.

Proposed MAP (high-level)
- 2025-05-22: Technical acceptance criteria (StratusAI engineers + Redwood SEs) — owner: StratusAI (Lila, Marco) / Redwood (Jonas, Aditya)
- 2025-05-27: Evaluation complete + performance sign-off (latency at target > 99th pct SLA) — owner: StratusAI
- 2025-05-29: Legal & procurement finalize payment path (AWS private offer ID or Redwood invoice) — owner: Procurement (StratusAI) / Kimberly (Redwood Sales Ops)
- 2025-06-02: PO issued / private offer activated or invoice agreed — owner: Procurement
- 2025-06-09: Dedicated capacity provisioned and reserved (3x A100-equivalent nodes) — owner: Redwood infra (Aditya)
- 2025-06-16: Go-live (production traffic) — owner: StratusAI ops

Notes on billing paths
- AWS Private Offer: StratusAI accepts bill via AWS, benefit: consolidated cloud billing. Time to activation depends on your procurement (AWS steps: private offer acceptance + marketplace activation). Typical cycle: 3–10 business days once legal approves the PO details.
- Redwood invoice: Redwood issues monthly invoices against an annual commit; requires Redwood finance approval and an executed MSA/Order Form. Estimated 7–14 business days for baseline customers.

SOC2 / security artifacts
- I'll cc our security lead and drop a short SOC2/KMS checklist. If you need an encrypted KMS flow for private deployments, we have a short tech note I can attach.

Next steps I propose
1) Review attached MAP draft (I've filled in owners for Redwood).
2) Quick 30-min sync to confirm private offer vs invoice and identify your legal contact. I'm open 5/22 11:00–12:30 PT.
3) I'll open a HubSpot task (STRAT-2025-047) and upload the MAP.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(attachment: StratusAI_MPA_DRAFT_v1.pdf, pricing-summary-stratusai.xlsx)

From: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@stratusai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lila Chen <lila@stratusai.com>
Cc: procurement@stratusai.com
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Starting MAP + AWS private offer question

Kimberly / Lila — thanks. A couple of procurement clarifications from our side: 

- We prefer AWS Private Offer, but procurement wants to confirm whether the private offer will allow us to reserve the exact instance types (we need A100-equivalent in us-west-2) and whether the private offer will show up as a separate line item with Redwood as the seller.
- Our billing team needs the exact legal entity and tax info to generate the PO. Who at Redwood handles this?
- We also need to confirm whether the Dedicated node provisioning requires additional lead time if we request fixed capacity (we are planning sustained throughput).

Forwarding our procurement mailbox note below for visibility. If it helps speed things up, we can accept a provisional private offer ID while legal finalizes the MSA.

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Procurement Team <procurement@stratusai.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 08:11:00 -07:00
To: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@stratusai.com>
Subject: PO checklist

Hi Marco,
Please capture vendor legal name, tax ID, billing contact, and whether the charge will be processed through AWS or directly invoiced. We aim to issue PO within two weeks if details are complete.

Regards,
StratusAI Procurement
(attachment: procurement-checklist.pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@stratusai.com>, Lila Chen <lila@stratusai.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 May 2025 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Starting MAP + AWS private offer question

Marco / team — thanks for the details. Quick answers and a pinned plan so procurement has what it needs: 

1) Legal entity & tax info
Redwood Inference, Inc.
EIN: 12-3456789
Billing contact: billing@redwood.com (Redwood Finance)

2) Private Offer specifics
- We can create an AWS Private Offer with Redwood as the seller and list the SKU for dedicated capacity (us-west-2, A100-equivalent). That offer will show as a line item in your AWS bill.
- Provisional private offer ID can be issued while MSA is in parallel; this is a common path for customers on a tight timeline.

3) Provisioning lead time
- For fixed reserved capacity (3x A100-equivalent) we typically need 5 business days from private offer activation/PO receipt to confirm reservation and start warm-up; 7–10 days to have everything at SLA-ready if we include networking/KMS setup.

Attached I'm sharing a short explainer on the private-offer flow and a redline checklist for the MSA. I've also created the HubSpot play (link above) and attached the draft MPA with explicit owners and dates. If that looks good we can: 

- Kimberly: issue provisional private-offer ID + send to Marco by 5/23 EOD
- StratusAI (Procurement): return signed PO or private-offer acceptance by 6/02
- Redwood infra (Aditya): provision reserved nodes 5 business days after activation

I'll also drop a DocuSign link for the Order Form once procurement confirms the billing path. Proposed 30-min sync: 5/26 10:00 PT — invite to follow.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.
(attachment: redwood-aws-private-offer-explainer.pdf, MSA-redlines-checklist.docx)
